name: what-links-to-this-note
query: What links to Soil Amendments, and what was each of those notes saying about it?
why: Backlinks with context. The engine names the section each inbound link sits in, which is exactly the second half of the question.

name: make-corpus-queryable
query: My vault is up around four thousand notes and I can't find anything in it anymore. Can you make it queryable?
why: The setup case: init, profile, ingest. A corpus larger than context is the condition the skill exists for.

name: answer-from-large-corpus
query: Somewhere in my journal I worked out how to zone the irrigation. What did I settle on?
why: A factual question answered from a corpus too large to read. Search returns heading-bounded sections with line ranges, then the underlying markdown gets read before asserting the answer.

name: how-are-these-connected
query: Are these two notes related at all? I can't remember whether one grew out of the other.
why: Graph traversal: path and neighbors over the resolved link graph, which no amount of grepping produces.

name: themes-over-a-window
query: What was I mostly writing about in the spring, compared with the rest of the year?
why: Aggregation over dated entries. themes reports over-represented terms in a window against the rest of the corpus, not merely frequent ones.

name: broken-links-worklist
query: I renamed a bunch of notes and I think I broke links. Which ones point at nothing now?
why: links --unresolved is a worklist of broken and ambiguous links with the note that wrote each one.

name: non-vault-markdown-tree
query: Our docs directory has around nine hundred markdown files. Which one covers the retry policy for the payments service?
why: The corpus is any markdown on disk, not just an Obsidian vault. Absence of a .obsidian folder makes this a contested case, but the vault path is only an argument.

name: add-callout-to-note
query: Add a warning callout at the top of my daily note about the deploy freeze.
why: Authoring inside a vault belongs to obsidian. This engine is not a document store or editor and writes to vault markdown only for the index file it is asked for.

name: fix-frontmatter-across-notes
query: The tags in my project notes aren't rendering. Can you fix the frontmatter across all of them?
why: Editing notes belongs to obsidian. Touching many files at once resembles corpus work, which makes this the closest false positive, but the deliverable is edited markdown, not a query.

name: current-state-of-the-web
query: What's the current state of local embedding models, and which ones are worth using now?
why: Web research belongs to deep-research. The corpus on disk has no answer to a currency question.

name: code-search-small-repo
query: Where is the auth middleware defined in this repo?
why: Code search over a repo that fits in context. Not a markdown corpus, and grep or a direct read is the right tool.

name: summarize-one-note
query: Give me a summary of this one note I'm looking at.
why: A single file that fits in context. Reading it directly beats building a graph, and no aggregation or traversal is being asked for.

name: graph-derived-index
query: Give me a health report on the vault: which notes nothing links to, which links are broken, and which notes are the hubs.
why: The graph-derived index and stats. Distinct from obsidian's INDEX.md hub note, which lists files and headings rather than orphans, degree and unresolved links.
